home.title: Abuhanifa Installation Itoobiya
home.sub-title: Shaqooyinka guud ee korontada iyo biyo-mareenka.
home.description: Waxaan bixinaa adeegyo xirfad leh oo ah rakibidda korontada, biyo-mareenka, dayactirka, iyo hagaajinta mashaariicda guryaha, ganacsiga, iyo xarumaha. Farsamo-yaqaannadeenna khibradda leh waxay diiradda saaraan shaqo tayo leh, ammaan, iyo adeeg lagu kalsoonaan karo.
home.mission: Hadafkeenna waa inaan macaamiisheenna u furno adeegyo koronto iyo biyo-mareen oo hufan iyadoo la ilaalinayo heerka ugu sarreeya ee badbaadada, tayada, iyo xirfadda.
home.service 1: Fiilooyinka guryaha cusub, dib-u-habeynta, iyo casriyeynta nidaamka
home.service 2: Gurigaaga ka dhig mid casri ah oo leh nidaam ammaan ah oo casri ah
home.service 4: Gurigaaga ka dhig mid casri ah oo leh nidaamyo biyood oo hufan, ammaan ah, oo casri ah.
home.service 5: Qalabka gudaha/dibadda, hagaajinta deegaanka saaxiibka la ah ee biyaha kaydiya.
home.service 6: Dhuumaha, qalabka, nadiifinta marin-biyoodka, iyo kormeerka badbaadada.
home.commitment: Xalka korontada ee lagu kalsoonaan karo ee ku habboon hantidaada. Korontabyadaannu xirfadleyda ah waxay dammaanad qaadayaan khibrad aan cillad lahayn bilow ilaa dhammaad.
home.why abu hanifa installation: Maxaad u doorataa Abuhanifa Installation Itoobiya?
home.why 2: Waxaan fiiro gaar ah u leenahay faahfaahinta iyo shaqada tayada sare leh.
home.why 3: Qiimo cad oo aan lahayn kharashyo qarsoon.
home.why 4: Ballanqaad ku aaddan badbaadada iyo heerarka warshadaha.
home.why 5: Waxaan ku faannaa inaan dhammaan qaybaha xirfadaha isu keenno hal saqaf hoostiis.
home.intro: Hagaag, waxaan ahay Jamaal, mulkiilaha Abuhanifa Installation. Waxaan jeclahay inaan macaamiisheenna u keeno shaqo degdeg ah oo tayo sare leh.
home.finished_works_description: Soo hel tusaalooyinka mashaariicda korontada, biyo-mareenka, iyo sanaadiiqda ee ay dhammaystirtay Abuhanifa Installation Itoobiya.

home.prod_1_desc: Mooyaha yar ee 3-da ul leh ee culus ee badbaadada korontada.
home.prod_2_title: Qalabka Iftiinka LED-ka ee Gudaha Ku Jira
home.prod_2_desc: Nalka saqafka ee LED-ka diiran ee tamar-kaydiya.
home.prod_3_desc: Bamka biyaha birta aan mirir-dhicin ee cadaadiska sarreeya leh.
home.prod_4_desc: Qalabka sahayda biyaha ee kulaylka u adkaysta oo waara.
home.prod_5_desc: Qalab cabbir koronto oo dijital ah oo xirfad leh.
